column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Hallelujah” is rendered “Praise the LORD!” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the favor of your people” is rendered “the favor You have toward Your people.”
Close to the Hebrew; לֹא־ הִשְׂכִּילוּ (“did not consider”) is rendered “did not understand,” and “the Sea of Reeds” “the Red Sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Sea of Reeds” is rendered “the Red Sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they hastened, they forgot” is rendered “They soon forgot.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they craved a craving” is rendered “lusted exceedingly.”
Close to the Hebrew; רָזוֹן (“a wasting”) is rendered “leanness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the holy one of the LORD” is rendered “the saint of the LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; מוֹשִׁיעָם (“their deliverer”) is rendered “their Savior.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Sea of Reeds” is rendered “the Red Sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the land of desire” is rendered “the pleasant land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he raised his hand to them” is rendered “He raised up His hand in an oath against them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sacrifices of the dead” is rendered “sacrifices made to the dead.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַיְפַלֵּל (“intervened, judged”) is rendered “intervened.”
